imports.name: EG Link output, recorded by players on WoW Forever
imports.notice:
Data from Efficient Games (https://efficient.games), licensed under CC BY 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Drop Tables changed it: only corpses looted solo on the
live servers, without quest items, summed over the builds and turned into Drop Tables counts.

imports.name: Everloot's public corpus, recorded by players on WoW Forever
imports.notice:
Data from Everloot (https://everloot.app), CC BY-SA 4.0. Drop Tables changed it: only the loot windows
of killed creatures, without quest items, counted per install and turned into Drop Tables counts, with
names, levels and places from the NPC sightings.
